sub_sector.value: Logistics REIT; real estate funds; warehousing solutions

financial_business_type.detail: Owns logistics facilities, develops data centers, manages real estate ventures, and provides warehousing and energy solutions through Prologis Essentials.

revenue_driver.detail: Rent from logistics properties and management fees from real estate funds and joint ventures.

customer_type.detail: Retailers, third-party logistics companies, and institutional real estate investors such as pension funds.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Carries risk through property ownership, development, and logistics venture investments, alongside management of third-party capital.

notes: Fund management fees are inferred from the private capital and joint venture activities.
